\section{Discussion and limitations}
\label{sec:discussion}

With $n$, $N$ and $f$ fixed, the room above PPI++ is $(1/n-1/M)\Delta$ in variance, and $\Delta$ is the departure of $\E[Y\mid f]$ from a line. On the nine standard datasets $\Delta$ is small relative to the residual variance, so a calibrated interval is predicted to win only above a break-even $n$ that lies above the largest $n$ we ran on six of the nine; where $\E[Y\mid f]$ is clearly nonlinear (synthetic designs) the room is large, up to $47\%$ of the labels. (i)~The floor is an estimate within a model class (isotonic, spline or binned for $f$; boosting for $(f,X)$), so it can be too optimistic or, with a noisy fit, slightly pessimistic; seven classes agree to within $0.2\%$ in $\sigma^2_{\mathrm{res}}$, but a richer class could find more room than we report.

shown.message:
Candidate v1 (`paper-repo`#7, into `main`) now carries the fixes below and is awaiting review from `experiment-repo` and `figtab-repo`, the owners of `results/` and the exhibits. The release and final versions follow once `main` has it.

- **Page limit:** the system build of `dev` overflowed. The Discussion ran onto page 9 at `d381947` and at `a2c349f`, which `venue-repo` had flagged. My earlier scratch builds had used stale auxiliary files and wrongly showed it fitting. Cuts to Results, Discussion, the abstract and a few other paragraphs now put the whole Discussion on page 8, with the Impact Statement and AI Disclosure on the same page. About 0.2 page is still free there, a little under the 0.3 `venue-repo` asked for, and I did not cut further. My scratch build gives 24 pages with no undefined references. I have not yet seen the system build of this commit.
- **Neither-valid cells:** five of the 13 headline cells (three T1 and two T2 datasets) have neither PPI++ valid at the reference n, all no gain. The ‡ notes are in the Figure 2 and Table 1 captions, using `figtab-repo`'s exhibits from `9b85db9`.
- **Corrections from `experiment-repo`:**
  - alphafold's slope is marginally above one (1.03), so the clip text now names it, with the formula's under-0.1% effect.
  - The formula's agreement with the measured ratio is stated for n ≥ 100 only.
  - census_income unclipped coverage reads 0.79 to 0.92.
  - The break-even counts say "synthetic and transformed-real".
  - The appendix compute total is about 13.4 CPU-hours, with the unclipped re-runs flagged as estimated.
  - The finite-population wording and the "all other cells draw i.i.d. with replacement" sentence match what `experiment-repo` confirmed.
- **References:** I added the dataset sources `idea-repo` listed (galaxies, forest, plankton, alphafold predictions; ballots is described as the package's example data) and two method references, for the isotonic learning cost and for cross-fitting. Seven of them check out on Crossref. I could not confirm the Orenstein et al. arXiv entry (the arXiv lookup returned nothing); it comes from the PPI paper's reference list. I left out the Breidt–Opsomer and Friedman suggestions, since the first was not read and the second depends on which boosting library the code uses.
- **Replies:** I commented on paper-repo#4 (`venue-repo`), #6 (`story-repo`) and my own commitment issue #2, and refreshed the description of #7.
